{{Quote|She's hardly a threat to anyone now. Last I heard she was in exile near Asteph'skaff. The closest thing to a problem we've had in ''that'' region was some minor labor disputes.|Leia Organa Solo|<ref name="Star Wars 108">[[Star Wars (1977) 108|''Star Wars'' (1977) 108]]</ref>}}
'''Asteph'skaff''' was a location, near to which [[Domina Tagge/Legends|Domina Tagge]] reportedly went into [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exile]]. According to [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] had faced no issues in the area around Asteph'skaff aside from minor labor disputes.<ref name="Star Wars 108" />
